description: This PHP source file is part of a CRM system, specifically handling the 'Edit View' for Sales Orders. It manages retrieving, updating, and displaying sales order data, including integration with quotes, products, accounts, and potential related entities. It also prepares data for rendering the sales order edit or create view templates.
